subject: Pilot MAP, legal sequencing & compressed close timeline for Sentinel Health
messages:
From: Dana Bloom <dana.bloom@sentinelhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 17 May 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot MAP & procurement timeline for Sentinel Health pilot

Hi Sergio —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Leadership wants to move the 6-week pilot to a signed pilot agreement, but procurement has asked for a mutual action plan (MAP) and a clear sequencing of MSA / DPA / Order Form sign steps before they will approve the budget window. They are also asking for a security checklist and SOC2 evidence.

Target: procurement would like signatures within two calendar weeks from today (hard ask due to Q2 budget cutoffs). Can Redwood commit to a compressed review cadence if we provide redlines quickly?

What we need from Redwood to kick:
- MAP with milestones & owners (legal, security, engineering, deployment)
- Draft Order Form to seat number and pricing
- DPA redline owner / proposed data retention language
- Security evidence bundle (SOC2 + questionnaire)

I can loop in procurement and legal on our side. If you can send a proposed MAP + owner contacts this afternoon that would be ideal.

Best,
Dana Bloom
Head of Platform Integrations
Sentinel Health
[Attachment: Sentinel_Issues_List.docx (docx, 24 KB)]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Bloom <dana.bloom@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 17 May 2025 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP & procurement timeline for Sentinel Health pilot

Dana —

Appreciate the clarity and the timeline. Attached is an initial MAP (MAP_Sentinel_v1.xlsx) and a one-page order-form draft. High level plan: 10 business day close assuming both sides turn redlines within 48 hours of receipt. Key sequencing notes below and owners we propose:

Milestones & owners
- Day 0: MAP & Order Form shared (Sergio Alvarez, Account)
- Day 1–2: Procurement review & cost confirmation (Sentinel procurement)
- Day 2–4: Redwood legal review / DPA owner aligns (Laura Bennett)
- Day 3–6: Security questionnaire & SOC2 bundle (Vanessa Ortiz)
- Day 6–8: Final redlines, DocuSign prep (Laura)
- Day 9–10: Signatures & kickoff

Dependencies / risks
- DPA retention clause: if Sentinel requests >5 years retention we will need product/engineering sign-off (affects deployment config).
- SOC2 artifacts: we can deliver the SOC2 report + summarized controls immediately; team will fill questionnaire within 48 hours of receiving it.
- Order Form: pricing as attached is pilot discounted; any seat count changes after signature will require amendment.

Attachments: MAP_Sentinel_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 36 KB); OrderForm_Draft_Sentinel.pdf (pdf, 28 KB)

If that sequencing works for you I can start the internal fast-track with legal and security now.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Sentinel — compressed MAP / legal sequencing (need owners & ETA)

Team —

Heads-up: Sentinel wants a 10-business-day compressed close for a 6-week pilot. I shared a MAP and order-form draft earlier. Can we fast-track reviews? Specific asks: 

Laura — can you own DPA redlines and target initial redline back by EOD Wed (21 May)? Key negotiation points: data retention cap, subprocessors list, incident notification SLA.
Vanessa — can security own the questionnaire and SOC2 artifact delivery? They will send a TrustAssure-style questionnaire; target turnaround 48 hours after receipt.
Karthik — FYI on any pricing SROs for pilot amendment if they change seats post-signature.

Suggested internal cadence: daily 9am stand sync until signature, ad-hoc legal drop-in Wed morning. If we can't get DPA back in two business days we lose their procurement window.

References: attached MAP and order-form draft.

Thanks — Sergio

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@sentinelhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dana Bloom <dana.bloom@sentinelhealth.com>, Sentinel Health Procurement <procurement@sentinelhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP & procurement timeline for Sentinel Health pilot

Sergio —

Thanks — procurement is aligned to try the compressed cadence. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Procurement asks for a single DocuSign link with MSA + DPA + Order Form combined (rather than separate flows). Is that possible?
2) Security will drop a questionnaire (TrustAssure link) this afternoon: https://trustassure.example.com/ques/SE-9042. We expect full answers + SOC2 within 48 hours.
3) Can Redwood confirm pricing is fixed for pilot (no retroactive seat changes) and provide a short cost-breakdown PDF for procurement?

We will provide redlines quickly; our legal can push within 24 hours if DPA is standard.

Available for a call tomorrow 10–11am PT if needed.

—Alex Mercer
Senior Procurement Manager
Sentinel Health
[Attachment: Sentinel_Security_Questionnaire_2025.pdf (pdf, 14 KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 May 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Sentinel — compressed MAP / legal sequencing (need owners & ETA)

Sergio / Vanessa —

I will own the DPA redline path. Plan:
- Wed 21 May (internal): draft initial redline for common clauses (retention, subprocessors, security obligations).
- Thu 22 May: incorporate Sentinel feedback; prepare combined MSA+DPA+OrderForm stack for DocuSign.
- Fri 23 May EOD: final internal sign-off and hand to ops for DocuSign prep.

Vanessa — please send SOC2 report and questionnaire responses to procurement contact (Alex) as soon as the TrustAssure link is received; copy me on delivery. If security needs any exceptions, flag them immediately so we can capture in an appendix rather than block signature.

Sergio — I'll also prepare a 1-page cost-breakdown and confirm the order-form pricing lock. If everything hits these milestones we should make their 10-business-day window. I will update the MAP with exact owner initials and dates.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
